convert_model_to_MOLE_model: convert a PyTorch model to use MOLE layers by replacing linear layers with mixture of linear experts
replace_linear_with_MOLE: replace an existing linear module with a MOLE or MOLEDGL mixture of linear experts layer
recursive_replace_so2_linear: recursively replace all linear layers inside SO2_Convolution modules with a provided replacement factory
recursive_replace_all_linear: recursively replace all torch.nn.Linear layers in a model with a provided replacement factory
model_search_and_replace: search model blocks and apply a module replacement function to specified layer indices
